content: Chew or swallow 200-400 mg orally three times daily with meals. Chew or swallow 200 mg orally three times daily with meals. Temporary darkening of the tongue may occur. Temporary discoloration of stool, appearing dark or black, may occur. Hypersensitivity reactions are possible. Exercise caution when administering this product to individuals with hepatic or renal impairment. When using this product, a temporary but harmless darkening of the stool and/or tongue may occur. In the event of an overdose, seek medical assistance or contact a Poison Control Center immediately. This product is not effective in reducing odor caused by inadequate personal hygiene. This product does not contain gluten, lactose, or salicylates. Store the product in a cool, dry place. Do not use if the outer safety seal or the printed inner safety seal is broken. Keep this product out of the reach of children. Consult a healthcare professional before using this product. Consult a healthcare professional before using this product. This product is generally considered safe for use during pregnancy. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
